mainProjects.name: Smart-VoterAI Verification System
mainProjects.description: A secure digital voting concept engineered with TypeScript. Features biometric identity verification, Aadhaar OCR text extraction simulation, JWT authentication, and role-based access control to prevent fraudulent duplicate voting.
highlights: Biometric facial match verification & Aadhaar OCR parsing pipeline
JWT-authenticated voting ballot submission with audit trace
Admin dashboard with live result tracking & zero duplicate voter checks

mainProjects.name: Gym-CRM Operations & Member Platform
mainProjects.description: A full-featured fitness and gym management CRM platform built with TypeScript. Implements member lifecycle management, recurring subscription tracking, trainer assignment workflows, and operational analytics.
highlights: Member lifecycle tracking with automated renewal reminders
Interactive membership analytics dashboard and trainer scheduling
Clean TypeScript architecture with responsive data tables
